case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your offer and the clear overview of your conditions.

Before we settle terms, two points from our records:

Your on-time delivery was 79.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).

Our orders of Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM with you were placed at EUR 29.89 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011517-10), EUR 29.89 on 2025-05-19 (po:4500012472-10), EUR 29.89 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013451-10) and EUR 29.89 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014436-10): the price has been unchanged.

We value working with Ravensteiner and want a footing that gives both sides planning security. Our proposal does that: a larger binding volume and a longer contract term, giving you firm load for your capacity planning well beyond a single year.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 25.66; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 24 months; lead time 42 days.

We would be glad to hear your view and are happy to talk it through.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Historical prices do not govern current agreements, and our standard lead time of 54 days is required to ensure delivery reliability. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We accept the proposed volume of 23,400 units and the 24-month contract term to support your planning security. Which volume can you commit to?

Our offer is a price of €34.00 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

Based on these parameters, we offer a revised unit price of EUR 32.10. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €32.10 per unit, under the alternative terms of a price of €32.10 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. Our offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your warm reply and for checking our data so carefully. We understand your position on the calculation and will not revisit those points.

We appreciate your alternative proposal and are glad to accept it as offered. You asked which volume we can commit to. The binding annual volume and the longer contract term below should give you the planning security you were looking for.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 32.10; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 24 months; lead time 56 days.

If this matches your understanding, we would be pleased to receive your confirmation so we can proceed.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We can accept your terms and await your order. We accept your proposal of EUR 32.10 per unit with a volume of 23,400 units, a 24-month contract, and a 56-day lead time.

We will prepare the contract documents accordingly. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands for 14 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
